profile.headline: Software Engineer at Applied Medical
profile.summary:
I am a full stack developer with a background in business and entertainment. Having previously worked in a variety of client-facing roles, I am well-versed in interpreting the needs of the user into actionable requirements for the projects I have worked on. 

I believe the best products are built by people from diverse backgrounds, and I enjoy working in a team environment where each member can contribute with their own perspective. I hope to draw from my experiences to build a product that makes a difference.

Skills: JavaScript, Python, React, Node.js, Express.js. Django, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, GraphQL, Azure Pipelines, Cypress

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Rancho Santa Margarita, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained an in-house learning management system used by thousands of global users.
• Engineered and provided technical advice on features to optimize the workflow of the Applied Learning team.
• Collaborated with project managers, business analysts, back-end developers, and UX/UI designers to deliver a web app that is optimized for both mobile and desktop.
• Coached new hires by providing clarification and assistance as needed and training them on the usage of Cypress for writing unit and integration tests.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · Webpack · Cypress · GitHub Actions · JavaScript · Auth0 · React.js · Playwright

positions.title: Agent's Assistant
positions.description:
• Established and maintained client relationships with the agency by advising them on insurance availability, eligibility, coverages, policy changes, claims, and billing.
• Constructed training manuals for and trained new hires on the use of State Farm business applications such as Salesforce and Agent’s Business System and how they interact with one another.
• Communicated with clients in both English and Vietnamese.

positions.title: Software Engineering Immersive Student
positions.description:
Full time immersive student in the Software Engineering program that included over 480 hours of professional training over twelve weeks. Utilized a hands-on approach to practice: JavaScript, Python, Node.js, React, Express, Django

Projects:

Mouser
• Developed and deployed a vacation planning tool for Disney Resorts.
• Built dynamic pages featuring rides, shops, and other attractions for users to interact with.
• Constructed forms to allow users to vote on others’ tips and tags and write their own on an attraction page.
• Implemented with JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express, Bootstrap, SCSS, MongoDB.

Jobber
•Built and deployed a career development website where users can view and register for recruiting, networking, and other career development related events.
• Set up authentication and authorization, allowing users to log in and sign up for accounts to keep track of and register for events.
• Constructed search functionality, allowing users to search for events by title and/or filter by category.
• Implemented with Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, Bootstrap.

positions.title: Disney College Program Intern
positions.description:
• Upheld the Disney brand by being friendly and attentive to Guest needs, ensuring a "magical" experience.
• Ensured Guest safety by verifying that they are within safety boundaries and that paths are free of safety hazards.

positions.title: Sales & Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
• Reconstructed the company’s filing system by integrating physical sales files into a digital database
• Provided administrative assistance to those in the Sales and Quality Assurance branches of the company
• Acted with discretion regarding sales files that related to the United States military

projects.title: Mouser
projects.description:
•  Mouser is an app that serves as a guide for vacationers planning their trip to one of the many Disney resorts. For every ride, shop, show, or other attraction, there is a corresponding page where users can learn more about it and contribute with their own tags and tip that can be voted on by other users.
•  Implemented with JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express, Bootstrap, MongoDB.

projects.title: Jobber
projects.description:
•  Jobber is a website where users can go search for networking and career development related events. Users can sign up and log in to register for and keep track of upcoming events.
•  Implemented with Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, Bootstrap.

organizations.name: Phi Chi Theta, Zeta Omicron Chapter
organizations.position: Vice President of Alumni Relations (2017-2018), Vice President of Fundraising (2016-2017) · May 2016 - Jun 2019
organizations.description:
Phi Chi Theta is a National coeducational Professional Fraternity in Business and Economics founded in 1924 in Chicago, Illinois. Phi Chi Theta's purpose is:

"To promote the cause of higher business education and training for all individuals, to foster high ideals for everyone pursuing a career in business; to encourage fraternity and cooperation among people preparing for such careers; and to stimulate the spirit of sacrifice and unselfish devotion to the attainment of such ends."
